ValidationRule.description: When an Opportunity is Closed Lost, both a Lost Reason and Closed Lost Notes are required (at least a sentence in length)
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( IsClosed, NOT(IsWon), ISBLANK(Loss_Notes__c), CloseDate >= DATE(2025,8,1) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: When an Opportunity is Closed Lost, both a Lost Reason and Closed Lost Notes are required (at least a sentence in length)
